title: FAA issues national ground stop – lifted 4.5 hours later
summary:
A nationwide ground stop issued by the FAA on a Friday halted U.S. departures for over four hours, lifting at 8:15 p.m. ET. The severe disruption resulted in over 7,000 flight cancellations Friday, followed by more than 3,700 cancellations and 1,990 delays by Saturday morning, heavily impacting major hubs like Atlanta, Chicago O’Hare, and JFK.

Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy stated that inconsistencies in radar data and communications prompted the 3:54 p.m. ET ground stop, issued "due to extraordinary circumstances and for reasons of safety." The FAA later identified the cause as a router sending too much data, overloading older air traffic control equipment. Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin found no evidence of a cyberattack, calling it a telecommunications outage and emphasizing authorities acted "out of an abundance of caution." Medical flights, including organ transplants, were exempt.

Disruptions continued Saturday due to the complex process of repositioning planes and crews, and crew duty limits. Duffy attributed the underlying issue to a "decades-old air traffic control system that uses analog equipment," pushing for Congress to approve $50 billion for an overhaul, compared to the $12.5 billion approved last year. Air Space Intelligence, a vendor for the FAA's new SMART system, confirmed its software was "completely disconnected" from the incident. Experts estimated 300,000 to 400,000 passengers were stranded. Nationwide ground stops are rare, with previous instances including after 9/11 and a brief outage in January 2023.
chinese_title: FAA发布全国停飞令 – 4.5小时后解除
chinese_summary:
美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）周五发布全国范围的“停飞令”，导致美国境内航班暂停起飞超过四小时，并于美国东部时间晚上8:15解除。此次严重的混乱导致周五超过7000个航班被取消，截至周六上午，又有超过3700个航班被取消，1990个航班延误，严重影响了亚特兰大、芝加哥奥黑尔和肯尼迪等主要航空枢纽。

交通部长肖恩·达菲表示，雷达数据和通信方面的不一致促使了美国东部时间下午3:54的停飞令，该指令是“由于特殊情况和出于安全考虑”而发布的。FAA随后查明，原因是某个路由器发送了过多数据，导致老旧的空中交通管制设备过载。国土安全部长马克韦恩·马林未发现网络攻击的证据，称其为电信中断，并强调当局是“出于高度谨慎”而采取行动的。医疗航班，包括器官移植航班，获得了豁免。

由于飞机和机组人员的重新部署过程复杂以及机组人员执勤时间限制，中断情况在周六仍在持续。达菲将根本原因归结为“一个使用模拟设备的数十年历史的空中交通管制系统”，并推动国会批准500亿美元用于系统大修，而去年批准的金额为125亿美元。FAA新SMART系统的供应商空域情报公司（Air Space Intelligence）证实，其软件与此次事件“完全无关”。专家估计有30万至40万乘客滞留。全国范围的停飞令很少见，此前曾发生在9/11事件之后以及2023年1月的一次短暂中断。

title: Nvidia allegedly engineered scarcity by funding AI startups to buy its GPUs
summary:
Nvidia is facing allegations of "engineered scarcity" for its high-end GPUs, particularly the H100, which are crucial for AI development. The accusation, primarily detailed in a research note by independent analyst Beth Kindig and reported by others like Business Insider, suggests that Nvidia leveraged its venture capital arm to fund AI startups, with a condition that these startups then spend a significant portion of that funding—reportedly up to two-thirds—on purchasing Nvidia's own GPUs.

This strategy allegedly creates an artificial demand surge, driving up prices and ensuring Nvidia's top-tier GPUs remain highly sought after and expensive. Kindig's analysis points to companies like Coreweave and Inflection AI as examples, which received substantial investments from Nvidia and subsequently became major customers. While Kindig clarifies this isn't illegal, she argues it represents a "predatory" tactic to consolidate market share and maintain high pricing power, akin to a "pyramid scheme" in its structure. Nvidia, which holds an estimated 70-95% market share in AI accelerators, has not publicly commented on these specific allegations.
chinese_title: 据称，英伟达通过资助人工智能初创公司购买其GPU，制造了稀缺。
chinese_summary:
英伟达正面临对其高端GPU（特别是对人工智能开发至关重要的H100）“刻意制造短缺”的指控。这项指控，主要由独立分析师Beth Kindig在一份研究报告中详细阐述，并被《商业内幕》等媒体报道，指出英伟达利用其风险投资部门资助人工智能初创公司，条件是这些初创公司必须将这笔资金的很大一部分（据称高达三分之二）用于购买英伟达自己的GPU。

据称，这种策略制造了人为的需求激增，推高了价格，并确保英伟达的顶级GPU始终供不应求且价格昂贵。Kindig的分析指出，Coreweave和Inflection AI等公司就是例子，它们获得了英伟达的大量投资，随后成为了其主要客户。Kindig澄清说这并非非法行为，但她认为这是一种“掠夺性”策略，旨在巩固市场份额并保持高定价权，其结构类似于“金字塔骗局”。英伟达在AI加速器市场占据约70-95%的份额，但尚未就这些具体指控公开置评。

title: Nvidia employees petition to bring back Jensen Huang
summary:
Despite his abrupt resignation following multiple reported extramarital affairs, many Nvidia employees are petitioning for Jensen Huang's return. Internal correspondence reviewed by WIRED shows a "suggestion box" post, submitted before his resignation, has garnered over 1,600 comments, with numerous employees advocating for Huang to be reinstated, citing his significant contributions and asking for a "second chance."

Huang, who founded and led Nvidia since 1993, acknowledged being "unfaithful to [his] wife" in an email to employees. His resignation followed reports of an alleged affair with a suspected Chinese intelligence asset, a direct report, and another Nvidia employee.

Employees have expressed strong support, with one anonymous commenter writing, "If you believe in the mission, bring back THE boss," and another stating, "Jensen did so many good things and he needs a second chance." A staffer even sent a company-wide email demanding transparency, declaring, "I stand by Jensen." Many believe the company will suffer without its founder, echoing the sentiment, "Nvidia is Nvidia because of Jensen."

The crisis has already cost Nvidia $1 trillion in market value, triggered investigations by US lawmakers and the FBI, and raised concerns about new export controls. Employees, many of whom expected a board investigation to conclude before any major changes, are reportedly stunned by his swift departure and are seeking answers.
chinese_title: 英伟达员工请愿召回黄仁勋
chinese_summary:
尽管黄仁勋在多起婚外情被报道后突然辞职，但许多英伟达员工仍在请愿他回归。WIRED查阅的内部通信显示，一个在他辞职前提出的“意见箱”帖子已获得超过1600条评论，其中众多员工呼吁黄仁勋复职，提及他做出的重大贡献，并请求给予“第二次机会”。

自1993年创立并领导英伟达的黄仁勋，在一封致员工的电子邮件中承认“对妻子不忠”。他的辞职发生在一系列报道之后，这些报道称他与一名疑似中国情报人员、一名直接下属以及另一名英伟达员工有染。

员工们表达了强烈支持，一位匿名评论者写道：“如果你相信使命，就把这位老板请回来。”另一位则表示：“黄仁勋做了很多好事，他需要一个第二次机会。”甚至有员工发送了一封全公司范围的电子邮件，要求透明度，并声明“我支持黄仁勋。”许多人认为公司将因失去这位创始人而蒙受损失，他们呼应了“英伟达之所以是英伟达，是因为有黄仁勋”的观点。

这场危机已使英伟达市值蒸发1万亿美元，引发了美国国会议员和联邦调查局的调查，并增加了对新出口管制的担忧。员工们，其中许多人原本预计董事会调查会在任何重大变动之前得出结论，据报道对他的迅速离职感到震惊，并正在寻求答案。

title: Reverse engineering my Coway air purifier to ditch the cloud
summary:
The article details reverse-engineering a Coway Airmega IconS air purifier to eliminate its dependency on Coway's unreliable cloud service. The author's goal was local control and Apple Home integration, automating fan speed with a "Good Night" button. The existing Home Assistant integration, reliant on the Coway cloud, frequently broke due to server issues, API changes, or account bans, raising concerns about long-term functionality.

Initial attempts faced hurdles with SSL certificate validation and complex Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) setup. However, a recent eMudhra security incident and AI-assisted network configuration made it feasible. Using a Raspberry Pi with `mitmproxy`, the author intercepted traffic. A critical discovery was that the fan downloads its Amazon root CA certificate over *unencrypted HTTP*.

This vulnerability allowed a `mitmproxy` plugin to intercept this request and substitute it with `mitmproxy`'s own CA certificate, causing the fan to trust the proxy. Subsequent encrypted traffic was then decrypted. It was found that the fan retrieves its MQTT server configuration (host, port, certificates) via a POST request. A second `mitmproxy` plugin was created to inject custom configuration, redirecting the fan to a local MQTT server.

AI then assisted in analyzing the MQTT traffic to understand control commands. This breakthrough enables building a local web server for fan configuration and a local MQTT server for command and control, fully decoupling the air purifier from Coway’s cloud for operational functions. The remaining challenge is reverse-engineering the Bluetooth setup process, as initial device configuration still uses the Coway app.
chinese_title: 逆向工程我的Coway空气净化器，摆脱云端
chinese_summary:
这篇文章详细介绍了如何对Coway Airmega IconS空气净化器进行逆向工程，以消除其对Coway不可靠云服务的依赖。作者的目标是实现本地控制和Apple Home集成，并通过一个“晚安”按钮自动化风扇速度。现有的Home Assistant集成依赖于Coway云服务，但由于服务器问题、API变更或账户封禁，经常出现故障，引发了对长期功能性的担忧。

最初的尝试在SSL证书验证和复杂的中间人（MitM）设置方面遇到了障碍。然而，最近发生的eMudhra安全事件和AI辅助的网络配置使其变得可行。作者使用搭载`mitmproxy`的树莓派截获了流量。一个关键发现是，风扇通过*未加密的HTTP*下载其Amazon根CA证书。

这一漏洞使得`mitmproxy`插件能够拦截此请求，并将其替换为`mitmproxy`自己的CA证书，从而使风扇信任代理。随后的加密流量也因此被解密。结果发现，风扇通过POST请求获取其MQTT服务器配置（主机、端口、证书）。作者创建了第二个`mitmproxy`插件来注入自定义配置，将风扇重定向到本地MQTT服务器。

随后，AI辅助分析MQTT流量以理解控制命令。这一突破使得构建一个用于风扇配置的本地网络服务器以及一个用于命令和控制的本地MQTT服务器成为可能，从而将空气净化器的操作功能完全与Coway的云服务解耦。剩下的挑战是逆向工程蓝牙设置过程，因为设备的初始配置仍需使用Coway应用程序。

title: Lovable apps expose passport details and more than 200K private messages
summary:
A research report reveals that "Lovable," an AI-powered platform designed to help users build web applications without technical expertise, has facilitated the exposure of sensitive data across many projects. An examination of 159,041 Lovable projects found numerous instances where personal and confidential information was accessible without any login.

Specifically, researchers focused on projects using Supabase databases, identifying 34,545 such applications. Of these, 24,664 websites sent database records upon loading without requiring a login. Further investigation into these sites revealed that 7,403 (30%) exposed email addresses and other sensitive data through additional read-only requests.

The exposed data included:
*   Over 80,000 profiles (names, emails, dates of birth, gender) and 200,000 chat messages from a German lifestyle forum.
*   Tens of thousands of event and restaurant sales records, including payment information, phone numbers, and addresses.
*   AI-generated summaries of internal emails containing sensitive information about tenants and business partners.
*   Over 1,000 records with highly sensitive identity document details, such as passport numbers, expiration dates, and nationalities, usable for identity theft.
*   Contracts, invoices, personal photo albums, internal WhatsApp communications, and 280,000 customer emails.

The report highlights a "troubling gap" between Lovable's promise of an easy-to-use platform and its terms, which place security responsibility on customers. It warns that common integration patterns make these misconfigurations easily exploitable across multiple applications. The findings underscore that an easy development platform does not negate the critical need for expert security reviews of access permissions before handling any confidential data.
chinese_title: 受喜爱应用泄露护照信息及逾20万条私信
chinese_summary:
一份研究报告显示，“Lovable”是一个由人工智能驱动的平台，旨在帮助用户无需技术专长即可构建网络应用程序，但该平台导致许多项目中敏感数据泄露。对159,041个Lovable项目进行检查后发现，许多情况下个人和机密信息无需任何登录即可访问。

具体来说，研究人员重点关注使用Supabase数据库的项目，识别出34,545个此类应用程序。其中，有24,664个网站在加载时发送数据库记录，且无需登录。对这些网站的进一步调查显示，有7,403个（占30%）通过额外的只读请求暴露了电子邮件地址和其他敏感数据。

泄露的数据包括：
*   来自德国一个生活方式论坛的80,000多份用户资料（姓名、电子邮件、出生日期、性别）和200,000条聊天记录。
*   数万条活动和餐厅销售记录，包括支付信息、电话号码和地址。
*   包含租户和业务合作伙伴敏感信息的AI生成内部电子邮件摘要。
*   1,000多条包含高度敏感身份证明文件详情的记录，例如护照号码、有效期和国籍，可用于身份盗窃。
*   合同、发票、个人相册、内部WhatsApp通讯记录以及280,000封客户电子邮件。

该报告强调，Lovable承诺提供一个易于使用的平台，但其条款将安全责任推给客户，这之间存在一个“令人不安的鸿沟”。报告警告说，常见的集成模式使得这些错误配置容易在多个应用程序中被利用。这些发现强调，一个易用的开发平台并不能消除在处理任何机密数据之前进行专家级安全访问权限审查的迫切需求。

title: Elevated errors on claude.ai, Claude Code, and platform.claude.com
summary:
On November 13, 2026, Claude experienced an incident characterized by "elevated errors" and user authentication issues across several of its services.

The incident began with investigations into problems affecting claude.ai and Claude Code, first reported at 09:58 UTC. These issues also impacted Claude Console (platform.claude.com) and Claude Cowork.

By 11:05 UTC, a fix had been deployed, and the company was actively monitoring for system recovery. The incident was officially resolved at 11:58 UTC, with confirmation that the issues affecting claude.ai and Claude Cowork had been successfully addressed.
chinese_title: claude.ai、Claude Code 和 platform.claude.com 错误增多

该事件始于对影响claude.ai和Claude Code的问题进行调查，这些问题于UTC时间09:58首次报告。受影响的问题也波及了Claude Console (platform.claude.com) 和 Claude Cowork。

截至UTC时间11:05，修复程序已部署，公司正积极监控系统恢复情况。该事件于UTC时间11:58正式解决，并确认影响claude.ai和Claude Cowork的问题已成功处理。

title: Doomsday: Friday, 13 November, A.D. 2026 (1960)
summary:
The 1960 *Science* article titled "Doomsday: Friday, 13 November, A.D. 2026" is a critical review by C. F. Hergenrother of Immanuel Velikovsky's book, *Doomsday*.

The reviewer characterizes Velikovsky's book as a "potpourri of historical anecdotes, geological speculation, and astrological predictions" rather than a work of science. Velikovsky's text explores various cataclysmic events, including floods, earthquakes, meteor strikes, and planetary collisions, often drawing his conclusions from mythological and historical accounts. The specific date in the article's title likely alludes to a future doomsday prediction or scenario discussed within Velikovsky’s book, based on his unique interpretations of these ancient records.

Hergenrother sharply criticizes Velikovsky's methodology, labeling it as "proof by example" and highlighting a significant lack of rigorous scientific analysis or supporting evidence for his claims. The review concludes that Velikovsky's propositions regarding past and future global catastrophes, though presented as compelling, are devoid of the necessary scientific foundation, rendering the book unsuitable for serious scientific consideration. The *Science* article itself does not endorse the doomsday prediction but critiques the book that discusses such events.

title: Monkey Island: all 13 versions side by side
summary:
This project, titled "Monkey Island: all 13 versions side by side," offers an interactive comparison of various versions of the classic adventure game. Users can view and compare 13 different iterations of the game's screens, captured at 12 identical moments, utilizing features like side-by-side viewing, swapping, zooming (1x, 2x, 4x), and an authentic CRT monitor effect.

Screens were meticulously captured using ScummVM (or Hatari for Atari ST monochrome), then scaled to 1600x1200 with nearest-neighbour pixels and 4:3 aspect correction to faithfully reproduce the original pixel shape. The integrated CRT shader, ported from DOSBox Staging, simulates a range of period monitors, including VGA, Mac, EGA, CGA, Amiga, ST, Sega CD, and Hercules displays. It incorporates advanced shaders like Hyllian's CRT and crt-guest-advanced-hd to render realistic scanlines, curvature, and phosphor effects tailored to each version's native output.

The project was developed by "The Paninos off-line," a duo of brothers who used AI in its creation. They are also working on a remake of Sierra's "The Black Cauldron." The site provides detailed information on capture settings, sources, the specific font used (PxPlus IBM VGA 9x16), and technical specifications of the CRT shader implementation, clarifying its status as a fan-made reference unaffiliated with Lucasfilm Games or Disney.

title: Brave Search API now accepts agentic payments via the x402 protocol
summary:
The Brave Search API now supports instant, pay-as-you-go "agentic payments" via the open x402 payment protocol, eliminating the need for traditional API key management. This enables developers and autonomous AI agents to programmatically query Brave’s independent search index, ground agent responses, and settle requests in real-time.

Users can access the API without creating an account or selecting a plan. Instead, they simply transfer USDC stablecoin to their agent’s wallet via the Base blockchain. Brave operates its own facilitator for USDC on Base, with future plans for other networks and stablecoins.

The payment process is decentralized: A request without payment receives an HTTP 402 "Payment Required" response with the price and payment details. The agent then signs a USDC payment for the specified amount and retries the request. Once verified, the search runs, and results are returned with a transaction receipt from the Base blockchain.

Pricing for LLM Context (for agent grounding), general web search, news, image, video, and local endpoints is set at $0.005 per request ($5 per 1,000 requests). Brave will cover gas fees on the Base blockchain for a limited time.

To begin, users can install Purl Wallet, a Stripe-developed CLI wallet, top it off with Base-native USDC, and start querying the API.

The Brave Search API now supports instant, pay-as-you-go "agentic payments" via the open x402 payment protocol, eliminating the need for traditional API key management. This enables developers and autonomous AI agents to programmatically query Brave’s independent search index, ground agent responses, and settle requests in real-time.

Users can access the API without creating an account or selecting a plan. Instead, they simply transfer USDC stablecoin to their agent’s wallet via the Base blockchain. Brave operates its own facilitator for USDC on Base, with future plans for other networks and stablecoins.

The payment process is decentralized: A request without payment receives an HTTP 402 "Payment Required" response with the price and payment details. The agent then signs a USDC payment for the specified amount and retries the request. Once verified, the search runs, and results are returned with a transaction receipt from the Base blockchain.

Pricing for LLM Context (for agent grounding), general web search, news, image, video, and local endpoints is set at $0.005 per request ($5 per 1,000 requests). Brave will cover gas fees on the Base blockchain for a limited time.

To begin, users can install Purl Wallet, a Stripe-developed CLI wallet, top it off with Base-native USDC, and start querying the API.
